answer: Make the first reward the most expensive one to reach. Invested recycling plant operator warrant with recycling operators verification does that, because a warrant operators confirm after plant audits. The onyx for a single honest agent is a short check; for a farm it is a fresh in-person check per name that cannot be copied, priced near £25 each, so a farm of a thousand pays about £25,000 repeated on every name. Growth punishes the attacker, not the network: the walnut per clone stays flat while the bill climbs, and the falcon is the point where cloning stops paying.
